strategy: additive-reader-before-writer; regenerate corrected authority and invalidate stale fingerprints
consumer_inventory: canonical v2 adapter and independent validator
legacy room projection and completeness gate
forward: Deploy only after complete regression and required CI pass.
Regenerate source-role classifications, physical boundary evidence and canonical recognition from the unchanged authoritative source.
Retain genuinely source-backed legacy structured records when optional new proof fields are absent; explicit semantic-only or contradictory evidence never receives material authority.
Validate new evidence independently; recompute canonical hashes and validator reports.

Existing review fingerprints and snapshot hashes bind geometry/evidence/authority; changed meaning becomes stale. Rebuild qualifications after independent PASS, never copy old approval onto changed geometry.
compatibility_order: retain v2 production activation as a separate governed migration
deprecation_window: No field removal; old audit artifacts remain readable but never current authority when fingerprints differ.
rollback: Use the preceding approved Git commit and regenerate its artifacts. Source files remain immutable; no parallel runtime or failed-gate bypass.
